test_title: PYST 38: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

In order to win the competition, one has to be __creative__.
solution:
The correct answer is **more creative**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of a **comparative degree** is appropriate here.
 
• In the sentence it is written that a person can win a competition only if he/she is better or more creative than others. 
 
 
• ***Example:** One has to be faster in order to win a race.*
 
 

Hence, **more creative** should substitute **creative** in the given sentence. 

 
• The correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• To describe, quantify, modify or identify nouns/pronouns, adjectives are used or reused. Adjectives have their own degrees called **degrees of adjectives** or degrees of comparison that compare one thing/person to another. 
 
• There are** three degree**s of comparison: **Positive, Comparative, and Superlative**. 
 
• Example:
 
 
• Riya is beautiful. (Positive degree)
 
• Riya is more beautiful than Diya. (Comparative degree)
 
• Riya is the most beautiful girl in our class. (Superlative degree)
